openQuestions.question: Does boarding cost anything beyond what the timetable gives (wait and ride), such as a fare, cooldown, noise or Trail?
openQuestions.why: I have set only headways, dwells and run times; no other cost is defined or invented here.

openQuestions.question: Is the wait a fixed readable schedule or a random draw within the headway, and are line phase offsets set?
openQuestions.why: This decides whether the player can predict the wait; I assumed independent arrivals.

openQuestions.question: Are loop turnaround times (T1 circus balloon loop, S1 Skyport loop) part of any journey, and can the cell board at a loop terminus?
openQuestions.why: The stop lists have no loop stops, and S1/skyport is not in the stop list, so it is not timetabled.

openQuestions.question: Do the plan's open questions stand: T1 extension to Crown Road, and the trunk replacing the Sphere loop and harbour line?
openQuestions.why: A different network would change the timetable.

notes: [S] Speed: average running speed including accel and braking, tram 8 m/s (~29 km/h), sky rail 12 m/s (~43 km/h). Run sec = chainage gap / speed, rounded.
[S] Headways: T1 150 s, T2 180 s, S1 120 s. Dwell: tram 20 s, sky rail 25 s. Starting values, tune by playtest.
Journey sec = in-vehicle ride plus dwell at each intermediate stop. Waiting for a service and walking between interchange stops are not included.
Cross-line journeys sum ride time on each line only; the second wait is not included.
Runs are symmetric in both directions on double track.
Beyond-sheet extents of T1 and T2 and S1 Skyport (not in the stop list) are not timetabled.
